items.name: Ability Teacher
items.overview: The Ability Teacher is located at the Frozen Village and the Magma Village.

items.name: Advanced Weapon Dealer
items.overview: The Advanced Weapon Dealer wears a black coat with a striped red dress shirt underneath, blue jeans with brown knee pads, and grey shoes. He also has golden brown gloves and utility belt, a black bandanna tied around his neck, a golden shoulder guard with a strap across his chest, and orange hair.

items.name: Adventurer
items.overview: The Adventurer wears brown clothes with skin-colored pants and skin-colored headbands with a white hat with orange lines, he uses the Heeeeeey face.

items.name: Agony
items.overview: Agony spawned every 20 minutes during the event, this spawn alternating between Agony and Ashen within the Grand Colosseum. He despawned after 9 minutes. When he spawned, the following system message "Pain takes form at the Colosseum." appeared. Agony revived as a Tormented Boss after he had low health, increasing his HP from 55,000 to 200,000. After he was defeated or time had passed, the message "Pain recedes." appeared.

items.name: Alchemist
items.overview: The Alchemist is located at the Green Zone, near the Marine Quest Giver. He can be easily found by following the path that leads to Orbitus and going to the left when a rock close to the quest giver is seen. The Alchemist will be underneath a blue mushroom and some leaves.

items.name: Ancient Beast
items.overview: The Ancient Beast is located on the 5th floor of a dungeon, typically being the first boss the player faces on any difficulty. He has 2 phases, similar to rip_indra True Form.

items.name: Ancient Monk
items.overview: The Ancient Monk is an NPC that teaches the Godhuman Fighting Style.

items.name: Ancient One
items.overview: The Ancient One is located at the Temple of Time, which can be accessed by speaking to the Mysterious Force NPC on top of Great Tree. After pulling the lever, the player can access the Trial Rooms. The Ancient One can be found near the bookshelf and right near the stairs leading to the Ancient Clock.

items.name: Ancient Vampire
items.overview: The Ancient Vampires usually come in waves, along with Ancient Zombies. They utilize Combat melee attacks, Flash Step and Aura, which means Elemental Reflex doesn't work on them.

items.name: Ancient Zombie
items.overview: The Ancient Zombies are Lv. 2000 enemies that are a part of the Trial of Carnage. They must be defeated in order to pass the Ghoul V4 race trial.

items.name: Angler (NPC)
items.overview: Players must reach at least Fishing level 20 to interact with the Angler. Upon interaction, the Angler provides three dialogue options, with some requiring specific conditions to unlock.

items.name: Arctic Warrior
items.overview: The Arctic Warriors wear an open, black parka with white fur linings and a hood, a pair of black and blue pants and a similarly colored shirt with a net-like pattern over them, and cyan boots. They also have black, scraggly hair, goggles, and a ski mask.

items.name: Area 1 Quest Giver
items.overview: The Area 1 Quest Giver can be found upon following the brown path between the Raiders and going up the slope, to the left.

items.name: Area 2 Quest Giver
items.overview: The Area 2 Quest Giver can be found near the Swan Pirates.

items.name: Arena Trainer
items.overview: The Arena Trainer is under the Hydra statue on the opposite side of where the Hydra Leader boss is located.

items.name: Arlthmetic
items.overview: arlthmetic is located at the Hot and Cold island, under the castle where Smoke Admiral spawns. The player should go to the back of the castle and see a big wooden door that is ajar and the play should walk in and find arlthmetic.

items.name: Arowe
items.overview: Upgrading a race will result in a race skill being unlocked, which is activated with the T key, and if the players Race is not Human, a cosmetic will be added to their avatar depending on the players current race (Only applies in game).

items.name: Ashen
items.overview: Ashen spawned every 20 minutes during the Celebration Event, this spawn alternating between Agony and Ashen within the Grand Colosseum. He would despawn after 9 minutes. Ashen appeared with a group of Lightning Bandits when he spawned.

items.name: Aura Editor

fields.location: Middle TownKingdom of RoseCastle on the Sea

items.overview: The Aura Editor is present in specific locations of every sea.

items.name: Awakened Ice Admiral
items.overview: The Awakened Ice Admiral wears a pair of light blue pants and vest, a very dark red (almost brown) dress shirt, a green bowtie and the Marine version of the Coat on his back. He also has bushy eyebrows, stubble on his chin and upper lip, and slicked brown hair.

items.name: Awakenings Expert
items.overview: The Awakenings Expert is an NPC that lets the player revert the awakened moves of their fruit back to the unawakened moves.

items.name: Baking Staff
items.overview: The Baking Staff wear a yellow shirt with buttons on each side of their abdomen area, along with a gold hood that covers the top of their head. They also wear blue-grey jeans.

items.name: Bandit
items.overview: The Bandits sport disheveled brown hair and, similar to the Trainees, have the Serious Scar Face. They wear a brown vest, paired with grey pants, and have slightly X-shaped bandages wrapped around their fists. Additionally, they wear black undershirts and shoes.

items.name: Bandit Quest Giver
items.overview: The Bandit Quest Giver wears a pirate hat with a red line and a skull with a semi-open red shirt and a red ribbon in his right hand with black pants and red shoes with black ropes, he wears the Heeeeeey face.

items.name: Barista
items.overview: The Barista allows the player to craft Aura, Dragon, and Eagle skins via drinkable concoctions of materials varying by recipe: Berries, Fire Feathers, and as materials; or alternatively purchasing them with . The recipes used for crafting Aura skins can be obtained from the Barista Cousin.

items.name: Barista Cousin
items.overview: The Barista Cousin spawns at a set location 20 minutes after a server starts, despawns after 20 minutes of being spawned, and respawns two minutes after despawning, which restarts the timer. This process will be repeated infinitely until a server is shut down.

items.name: Bartilo
items.overview: This quest is needed to be completed in order to talk to the Alchemist and upgrade the player's Race to V2.

items.name: Beast Hunter (NPC)
items.overview: The Beast Hunter can be found at the Tiki Outpost, to the right of the Boat Dealers, in the green-mossy building's top floor.

items.name: Beautiful Pirate
items.overview: The Beautiful Pirate has two appearances:

items.name: Blacksmith
items.overview: Players must upgrade their weapons through the Blacksmith before being able to enchant them.

items.name: Bladesmith
items.overview: The Bladesmiths have blonde, short hair, a black bandana covering their mouth, a dark shirt without sleeves, and two silver arm wears.

items.name: Blox Fruit Dealer

fields.location: Pirate StarterMarine StarterMiddle TownKingdom of RoseCaféPort TownMansion

items.overview: The Blox Fruit Dealer wears a black chainmail shirt with a brown belt, and a red shirt and pants underneath it. He has brown, short hair, and wears black, cross-strapped sandals, and a black tricorn with a red lining. His skin is moderately tanned.

items.name: Blox Fruit Gacha
items.overview: Every two hours, the player is able to purchase a random physical Blox Fruit at the cost of Money depending on their level. It has a significantly smaller chance of getting a good fruit compared to the spawn chance.

items.name: Blox Fruits Dealer Cousin
items.overview: The Blox Fruits Dealer Cousin would give players a random physical Blox Fruit if they paid Money . The player could end up getting any fruit in the game; each fruit had a different chance of obtaining from him, the rare ones usually being more difficult to obtain.

items.name: Bobby
items.overview: Bobby had a clown nose with blue hair, a cross-bone tattoo across his face with two scars cutting through each eye, an orange pirate hat with black shoes, some white pants with a blue belt and a green and white striped shirt with red gloves. He also wore a red scarf around his neck bearing a green gem bordered with yellow casing.

items.name: Bone Wraith
items.overview: The Bone Wraiths could appear after opening a Cursed Chest.

items.name: Bounty/Honor Expert
items.overview: The Bounty/Honor Expert can be found in the Second Sea, in the Café next to tort, as well as on Floating Turtle in the Third Sea, next to the Awakenings Expert.

items.name: Brute
items.overview: The Brutes wear a brown shirt with a black vest and also wear blue pants and gray shoes. Additionally, they have black hair and a "Hmmm" face.

items.name: Butler
items.overview: Like the Customer of the Second Sea, this NPC gives information about the Third Sea and the items in it, usually through vague references, cryptic messages, numerous hints related to puzzles, and occasional events.

items.name: Cake Guard
items.overview: The Cake Guards are found in the Cake Island sub-area of the Sea of Treats, located in the Third Sea. They can also be found in Dungeons.

items.name: Cake Prince
items.overview: The Cake Prince is summoned if the player interacts with drip_mama after 500 enemies have been defeated at the Cake Land.

items.name: Cake Queen
items.overview: Server hopping for the Cake Queen is a good way to farm mastery, money and Bounty/Honor. Her health and damage output is very high, so if possible, the player should get a good powerful fruit (such as Buddha), sword, and/or other people to assist them.

items.name: Cake Quest Giver 1
items.overview: The Cake Quest Giver 1 can be found in the Cake Land of Sea of Treats, between the Cookie Crafters and Cake Guards.

items.name: Cake Quest Giver 2
items.overview: The Cake Quest Giver 2 can be found in the Cake Land of Sea of Treats, under a tree near the Baking Staff.

items.name: Cake Scientist
items.overview: To access the Cake Scientist's room, the player needs to get a Red Key, which is a guaranteed drop of Dough King. After obtaining the key, the player must walk to the door to the Cake Scientist's room with the key equipped.

items.name: Candy Cane Quest Giver
items.overview: The Candy Cane Quest Giver can be found in the North Pole of Sea of Treats.

items.name: Candy Pirate
items.overview: The Candy Pirates wear a brown coat with a red sweater underneath, black pants with a black belt and silver buckle, and black boots with white fur around the tops. They also have brown, spiky hair, a red and white striped scarf, and Aura on their fists.

items.name: Candy Rebel
items.overview: The Candy Rebels are found in Chocolate Land, Sea of Treats, in the Third Sea.

items.name: Captain Elephant
items.overview: Captain Elephant wears a damaged brown shirt with purple pants and brown shoes with yellow hair and the Jaw Shield in his mouth. He also has grey skin and uses Aura.

items.name: Celebration Teleporter
items.overview: The Celebration Teleporter was an event-related NPC.

items.name: Celestial Fisherman
items.overview: The Celestial Fisherman can be found in the Celestial Domain, on the left side of the Spirit Tree area.

items.name: Celestial Gacha
items.overview: The Celestial Gacha is located on one of the islands within the Celestial Domain.

items.name: Celestial Member
items.overview: During the RIP Event, the Celestial Member allows players to teleport into the Celestial Domain.

items.name: Celestial Soldier
items.overview: The Celestial Soldiers spawn every five minutes in the Celestial Domain. Whenever they spawn, a system message will appear, saying: "Celestial Soldiers are patrolling nearby." A total of 16* Celestial Soldiers can exist. (Two islands on the ground level, two islands in the sky near the center tower.)

items.name: Chef
items.overview: The Chef is located in the Pirate Village, outside the yellow house in front of the Brutes.

items.name: Chief Petty Officer
items.overview: The Chief Petty Officers have black hair and wear the Serious Scar Face with the Marine uniform.

items.name: Chief Warden
items.overview: The Chief Warden wears a pair of emerald-green cargo shorts with silver, diamond shaped studs, and brown shoes. He has an Egyptian headdress, with black bat-like wings growing from his back. He does not wear a shirt, and his chest is consequently visible.

items.name: Chocolate Bar Battler
items.overview: The Chocolate Bar Battlers are found at Chocolate Land in Sea of Treats, Third Sea.

items.name: Chocolate Quest Giver 1
items.overview: The Chocolate Quest Giver 1 can be found in the Chocolate Land of Sea of Treats, in front of a rock between the Cocoa Warriors and Chocolate Bar Battlers.

items.name: Chocolate Quest Giver 2
items.overview: The Chocolate Quest Giver 2 can be found in the Chocolate Land of Sea of Treats.

items.name: Citizen
items.overview: The Citizen can be found near the Mansion, Third Sea.

items.name: Cocoa Warrior
items.overview: The Cocoa Warriors are located at the Chocolate Land.

items.name: Colors Specialist
items.overview: If a player interacted with the Colors Specialist, they could equip all of the colors that the player had purchased from the Master of Auras, by the Horned Man quest, by the event shop or bought with Robux . The player could also disable the color, returning it to the original black Aura.

items.name: Colosseum Quest Giver
items.overview: The Colosseum Quest Giver is located at the path between the Toga Warriors and the Gladiators, near a pillar.

items.name: Cookie Crafter
items.overview: The Cookie Crafters have spiky pink hair and wear a green shirt with yellow circles, along with brown pants and pink shoes.

items.name: Coral Pirate
items.overview: The Coral Pirates are located at the Submerged Island to the right of spawn at some buildings.

items.name: Core
items.overview: The Core spawns in 1 hour and 30 minutes. When the Factory Raid starts, players have five minutes to destroy the core. Otherwise, the door will close, and a poison will spread, killing all players who are still in the factory.

items.name: Cousin Remastered
items.overview: The Cousin Remastered was placed in Middle Town.

items.name: Crew Captain
items.overview: If the player does not own a crew or does not have enough fragments to purchase a crew slot, the Crew Captain will say "What's up?"

items.name: Crypt Master
items.overview: The Crypt Master is located by the tall stone building behind the Mansion on the Floating Turtle, he will open the door to the Crypt.

items.name: Cupid Valentine Quest Giver
items.overview: The Cupid Valentine Quest Giver was a Quest NPC.

items.name: Cursed Captain

fields.spawnTime: Every 3 Nights (Guaranteed In The First Full Moon Of A Server)

items.overview: The Cursed Captain spawns every 3 nights (guaranteed in the first full moon of a server), in the middle of a big room located at the second floor of Cursed Ship, Second Sea.

items.name: Cursed Skeleton
items.overview: The Cursed Skeletons can spawn in both the Heaven Dimension and the Hell Dimension.

items.name: Cursed Skeleton Boss
items.overview: The Cursed Skeleton Boss is located at the Crypt, at Floating Turtle, in Third Sea.

items.name: Customer
items.overview: The Customer can be found standing close at the counter near the Manager in The Café, which is located in the Second Sea.

items.name: Cyborg (Boss)
items.overview: The Cyborg has a robotic left arm with a blue vest, yellow shirt, and black pants with snow white spiky hair. Cyborg is also wearing blue goggles and iron nails on his face. He uses Rocket as his main attacking method.

items.name: Cyborg (NPC)
items.overview: If the player does not have enough fragments, the Cyborg will say:

items.name: Dangerous Prisoner
items.overview: The Dangerous Prisoners wear a red shirt with black lines and black shoes and black hair, they wear the Serious Scar Face.

items.name: Dark Master
items.overview: The Dark Masters wear white and blue pants with brown and black shoes and also wear white and brown clothes with purple hands and black wings on their back with a balaclava.

items.name: Dark Step Teacher

fields.location: Pirate VillageHot and ColdCastle on the Sea

items.overview: The Dark Step Teacher teaches the player Dark Step for 150,000.

items.name: Darkbeard
items.overview: "The power of darkness has been unleashed."

items.name: Deandre
items.overview: Deandre can spawn in various places in the Third Sea, all spawn locations can be found here.

items.name: Death King
items.overview: The Death King is located in a mausoleum in the graveyard of the Haunted Castle, Third Sea.

items.name: Deep Forest Area 2 Quest Giver
items.overview: The Deep Forest Area 2 Quest Giver can be found near in between the Musketeer Pirate's camp and the valley of the Pineapple Houses.

items.name: Deep Forest Quest Giver
items.overview: The Deep Forest Quest Giver can be found near the Mansion (Third Sea), close to the Forest Pirates.

items.name: Demonic Soul
items.overview: The Demonic Souls can be found inside the Haunted Castle, Third Sea.

items.name: Desert Adventurer
items.overview: The Desert Adventurer is located at the Desert, First Sea.

items.name: Desert Bandit
items.overview: The Desert Bandits wear a white and grey vest and shirt, in addition, they wear black pants and a balaclava with glasses that completely covers their face.

items.name: Desert Officer
items.overview: The Desert Officers have black hair with dark green parts at the ends, they also wear a brown shirt and pants at the end and they use the "Raig Face".

items.name: Diablo
items.overview: Diablo can spawn in various places in the Third Sea, all spawn locations can be found here.

items.name: Diamond (Boss)
items.overview: Diamond is a tall, medium-sized man with a variety of leaves forming a shape behind his head. He also wears a green shirt which exposes his chest, along with brown pants with some visuals in it.

items.name: Dog House (Indra)
items.overview: In the First Sea, if the player does the right dialogue, A part of The Son Quest will be completed, Giving them a quest to find love letters. The love letters are scattered across the map in the Frozen Village, Marine Fortress, and Skylands.

items.name: Dog House (Wenlock)
items.overview: The Wenlock Dog House is located to the left of the Arowe NPC, inside a secret room located under the Diamond boss.

items.name: Dojo Trainer
items.overview: The Dojo Trainer is located inside the Dragon Dojo, in Hydra Island.

items.name: Don Swan
items.overview: Don Swan wears a black robe with maroon stripes, which is short enough to reveal muscles on his arms and torso, and maroon shoes. On his back, he wears the Pink Coat, and has black, spiky hair, a large, toothy grin, as well as a pair of Swan Glasses.

items.name: Dough King
items.overview: "A dimension worthy of a god has spawned."

items.name: Dragon Crew Archer
items.overview: The Dragon Crew Archers wear a white and yellow shirt with red, black and white pants with bandages on their hands and an orange bandanna covering their mouth with orange hair. They use the Serious Scar Face.

items.name: Dragon Crew Quest Giver
items.overview: The Dragon Crew Quest Giver can be found near the Friendly Arena, close to the Dragon Crew Warriors.

items.name: Dragon Crew Warrior
items.overview: The Dragon Crew Warriors wear orange and black shirts with brown and yellow bandages with red, white, yellow, and black pants with sandals and red hair with horns, they use the Classic Vampire face.

items.name: Dragon Hunter
items.overview: The Dragon Hunter is located at the Dragon Dojo in Hydra Island, Third Sea.

items.name: Dragon Talon Sage

fields.location: JungleMiddle TownSnow MountainKingdom of RoseCaféTiki Outpost

items.overview: The Dragon Talon Sage is an NPC who allows players to craft Scrolls and apply Enchantments to weapons.

items.name: Dragon Tamer
items.overview: The Dragon Tamer can be found in two seas:

items.name: Dragon Wizard
items.overview: The Dragon Wizard wears a red cape, black shirt and pants, seems to have a brown and red-stripped wizard hat, a long, white beard, and a calm expression.

items.name: Drip mama
items.overview: drip_mama allows the player to see how many more enemies they need to defeat to summon Cake Prince or Dough King raid. (Note: It will only count the amount of killed NPCs on the Cake Land.)

items.name: El Admin
items.overview: El Admin can be found in the middle room of the left-side sleeping quarters of the Cursed Ship. The player must be at least Lv. 1000 to enter the Cursed Ship through the door.

items.name: El Perro
items.overview: El Perro is located next to the Ship Deckhands on the right side of the Cursed Ship exit, beside a bed.

items.name: El Rodolfo
items.overview: El Rodolfo is found at the bottom floor of the Cursed Ship near the Ship Engineers. The player must be at least Lv. 1000 to enter the Cursed Ship.

items.name: Elite Hunter
items.overview: Elite Hunter is a quest NPC that gives players quests to defeat one of the three Elite Pirates and Tyrant of the Skies.

items.name: Elite Pirates

fields.purpose: Obtaining God's Chalice, Dojo Belt (Purple), and Yama

items.overview: Currently, there are three Elite Pirates in the game: Deandre, Diablo and Urban. However if Tyrant of the Skies is spawned, he can be defeated as an Elite Pirate.

items.name: Erin
items.overview: Erin is an NPC whose only purpose is to show the player the fighting scene between rip_indra and mygame43.

items.name: Event Shop
items.overview: The Event Shop is a special NPC shop that appears during limited-time events. Players can exchange event-specific materials for items from a rotating stock.

items.name: Evil Wraith
items.overview: The Evil Wraiths could be spawned by opening a Cursed Chest.

items.name: Experienced Captain
items.overview: The Experienced Captain is located at the Middle Town and on the docks of the Port Town.

items.name: Experimic
items.overview: Experimic will change the player's race to Ghoul after paying 100 Ectoplasms and a Hellfire Torch. This purchase is permanent, meaning the player will not lose access to Ghoul upon switching to another Race.

items.name: Factory Staff
items.overview: The Factory Staff wear a scientist suit with safety goggles that cover their eyes and have black hair.

items.name: Fajita
items.overview: Fajita had brown, bushy hair, eyebrows and a beard, and a straight scar across the top of his nose. He wore the marine version of the Coat with golden decoration and a black collar, a green robe with a maroon edge, and brown pants. He also held the Gravity Blade.

items.name: Felku
items.overview: Currently only being seen in trailers and bulletins, 'Felku' seems to be an 'enemy' of Shafi, being partnered up with Suizei. He is the leader of a 'BAMP' lair. He claims to be the King of Fruits.

items.name: Female Islander
items.overview: The Female Islanders wore a red, yellow and black shirt with black pants and black shoes with a white, yellow and black necklace on their neck and red hair. They use the Winky face which is similar to Kilo Admiral's.

items.name: Fire Quest Giver
items.overview: The Fire Quest Giver can be found on the Hot side of Hot and Cold, near the stone path leading to the Smoke Admiral.

items.name: Fish Crew Member
items.overview: The Fish Crew Members have Shark V3 visuals. They can have different skin colors: blue, green, pink, or red. They can also have different hair styles.

items.name: Fisherman
items.overview: Players can get a Fishing Rod and 10 Basic Baits by interacting with the Fisherman for the first time. Afterwards, the player is able to check their Job Stats, Fishing Index, sell Fishes and buy 10 Basic Baits for 1,000 (Basic Bait stacking caps at 99).

items.name: Fishman Captain
items.overview: The Fishman Captains wear an open green shirt with damaged blue pants and two red bandages, one on their pants and another on one chest with black and brown sandals with green spiked hair. They use the Mildly Irritated Face.

items.name: Fishman Commando
items.overview: The Fishman Commandos can be found at the right side of the Underwater City.

items.name: Fishman Lord
items.overview: The Fishman Lord has two appearances which are:

items.name: Fishman Raider
items.overview: The Fishman Raiders wear an open black shirt with a green collar and sleeve bands, blue shorts, and a red necktie. They also wear yellow knee-covers and black sandals. They have jet-black, messy hair, mint-green skin, and muscles on their chests and arms.

items.name: Fishman Warrior
items.overview: The Fishman Warriors wear a blue shirt and pants with green lines on their clothes and a red ribbon on their chest, they have pink skin with blue hair and use the face Heeeeeey.

items.name: Forest Pirate
items.overview: The Forest Pirates wear a white shirt with white and red pants with orange shoes and red spiky hair. They use the The Big Dog Face.

items.name: Forgotten Quest Giver
items.overview: The Forgotten Quest Giver can be found behind the skull of Forgotten Island, near the Water Fighters.

items.name: Fossil Expert
items.overview: The Fossil Expert can be found in the Prehistoric Island, Third Sea.

items.name: Freezeburg Quest Giver
items.overview: The Freezeburg Quest Giver can be found to the left of the main entrance of Fountain City, near the Galley Pirates.

items.name: Front Crew Quest Giver
items.overview: The Front Crew Quest Giver can be found near the stairs leading to the second floor of the Cursed Ship, in front of the entrance to the Ship Stewards.

items.name: Frost Quest Giver
items.overview: The Frost Quest Giver can be found to the left of the Ice Castle, near the Snow Lurkers.

items.name: Frozen Watcher
items.overview: The Frozen Watcher is an NPC that is required for the player to interact with in order to spawn the Leviathan.

items.name: Galley Captain
items.overview: The Galley Captains wear black and white clothes and pants, their face is the "Raig Face" and they wear the "Rising Sun Samurai" hat.

items.name: Galley Pirate
items.overview: The Galley Pirates wear grey and black clothing, a grey helmet with four spikes and a red dot in the center, they use the Raig Face.

items.name: Gas Knight
items.overview: The Gas Knight is located on the 15th floor of a dungeon. He is the final boss on Easy Mode, not in Hard and Challenge mode (Due to Zero being the last).

items.name: Ghost (Enemy)
items.overview: Ghosts wear a torn brown shirt with torn black pants with white fur. They use the Zombie Face.

items.name: Ghost (NPC)
items.overview: The Ghost NPC is located at the Haunted Castle, Third Sea.

items.name: Giant Islander
items.overview: The Giant Islanders wore a red, skin and black headband with white lines with black pants with the same headband and orange hair. They had the Miss Scarlet Face.

items.name: Gladiator

fields.immunityLevel: 277 (doesn't works on Level 278) but works again after Level 279

items.overview: The Gladiators wear yellow and white shirts and pants and also wear an iron helmet that covers their entire face except their eyes.

items.name: God's Guard
items.overview: God's Guards wear a purple shirt with blue pants and a yellow headband with black shoes and a white artist hat with their Angel Wings on their back, they use the Mildly Irritated Face.

items.name: Gorilla
items.overview: The Gorillas have unkempt black hair and a grey-pink face. They have a hairy body, a six-pack, and dark hairs around their fists.

items.name: Gorilla God
items.overview: The Gorilla God can be found in the Dungeons, in one of the random floors on Hard Mode leading up to Zero.

items.name: Grand Devotee
items.overview: The Grand Devotees are located at the Submerged Island near the High Disciples in a temple like building.

items.name: Gravestone
items.overview: The Gravestone is located at the Haunted Castle.

items.name: Graveyard Quest Giver
items.overview: The Graveyard Quest Giver can be found at the main island of Graveyard Island, among the Zombies.

items.name: Greedy Elf
items.overview: The Greedy Elf can be found near center of North Pole in First Sea and Second Sea or Candy Cane Land in Sea of Treats in Third Sea.

items.name: Greybeard
items.overview: "Loud tremors are being heard across the seas..."

items.name: Guashiem
items.overview: Guashiem is very easy to find as he is the only NPC in the Cursed Ship that looks like a dog/white kitsune.

items.name: Halloween Gacha Dealer
items.overview: The Halloween Gacha Dealer was an event NPC.

items.name: Hasan
items.overview: Hasan is located in the secret tunnel under the silver chest near the pyramid on the Desert. The player must walk through the passage, then jump at the end to enter the pyramid and meet Hasan.

items.name: Haunted Castle Quest Giver 1
items.overview: The Haunted Castle Quest Giver 1 can be found inside the grey hut, in the center of the Haunted Castle.

items.name: Haunted Castle Quest Giver 2
items.overview: The Haunted Castle Quest Giver 2 can be found near the front door of the Haunted Castle, near the Demonic Souls.

items.name: Haunted Crew Member
items.overview: The Haunted Crew Members also leave a bluish-green glow similar to Ghost's Resurrection Passive.

items.name: Head Baker
items.overview: The Head Bakers wear an open, golden jacket that shows their muscles, and blue jeans with gold and purple shoes. They wear a golden helmet with a face guard and a green necktie. Their fists are also black due to them being imbued with Aura.

items.name: Head Jailer
items.overview: The Head Jailer is located at the front of Swan's spawn castle, to the left in the Prison .

items.name: Heaven's Guardian
items.overview: The Heaven's Guardian appears after lighting up the third torch in the Soulless scroll quest. He uses the awakened old version of the Light fruit and he possesses the Angel race but doesn't have any abilities or buffs from it. Most of his attacks cannot be dodged because of the fast start-up of the moves. He also utilizes Aura.

items.name: Hell's Messenger
items.overview: The Hell's Messenger appears after lighting up the third torch in the Fear the Reaper scroll quest. He uses the awakened version of the Dark fruit and also utilizes Aura. He is easier to beat than Heaven's Guardian mostly due to the attacks being easy to dodge.

items.name: High Disciple
items.overview: The High Disciples are located at the Submerged Island to the right of spawn near the back of the island.

items.name: Horned Man
items.overview: To begin the quest, talk to the Horned Man. He will then tell the player to defeat these Bosses in order:

items.name: Horned Warrior
items.overview: The Horned Warriors wear blue clothing with a blue hat and ice blue horns with a mask that covers their mouth.

items.name: Hungry Man
items.overview: The Hungry Man wears a brown, raggedy pair of pants and shirt, which have had their sleeves torn off, and are riddled with various holes. He wears no shoes, and is also bald, and has no hat to cover his head.

items.name: Hydra Enforcer
items.overview: The Hydra Enforcers are Lv. 1625 enemies.

items.name: Hydra Leader
items.overview: The Hydra Leader wears a black and purple outfit and a purple band around her waist. She has a black mask covering the majority of her face and wear a black conical hat on her head. Her outfit is similar to the Venomous Assailants'.

items.name: Hydra Town Quest Giver
items.overview: The Hydra Town Quest Giver can be found near the lake of Hydra Town, close to the Dragon Dojo.

items.name: Ice Admiral
items.overview: The Ice Admiral wears a white suit vest, and white pants, along with a red dress shirt underneath. He also has a green bowtie, black shoes, combed hair, and bushy eyebrows. He wears the marine version of the Coat, which hangs off his back, and has visible muscles on his legs and arms.

items.name: Ice Cream Chef
items.overview: The Ice Cream Chefs are located at the Sea of Treats.

items.name: Ice Cream Commander
items.overview: Ice Cream Commanders are located at Sea of Treats, Ice Cream Land, Third Sea.

items.name: Ice Cream Quest Giver
items.overview: The Ice Cream Quest Giver can be found in the Ice Cream Land of Sea of Treats, near the Ice Cream Chefs.

items.name: Ice Quest Giver
items.overview: The Ice Quest Giver can be found at the left side of the door leading to the gray tower at the Cold side of Hot and Cold, near the Lab Subordinates.

items.name: Indra Egg
items.overview: To access this boss, the player must collect the first 23 Eggs in the Easter Egg Hunt Codex. The player can then interact with the Easter Shop NPC and select the "Secret" dialogue option to get a free Easter Chalice at the first time or trade 2,000 Candy Eggs for it in the 2nd or above time.

items.name: Instinct Teacher
items.overview: The Instinct Teacher is located at the Aztec-like Temple structure within the second area of the Upper Skylands, to the left of the Thunder God Boss.

items.name: Island Boy
items.overview: The Island Boys have long brown hair, with their muscles exposed and tattoos on both of their arms. In addition to this, they wear a necklace, a pair of gloves, along with short blue jeans and brown shoes.

items.name: Island Empress
items.overview: The Island Empress spawned every 25 minutes. She was located in front of the palace at the Hydra Island in the Third Sea.

items.name: Isle Champion
items.overview: The Isle Champions are located at the Tiki Outpost.

items.name: Isle Outlaw
items.overview: The Isle Outlaws are located in Tiki Outpost near the Tiki Quest Giver 1.

items.name: Jail Keeper
items.overview: The Jail Keeper is located to the left of where Swan spawns.

items.name: Jeremy
items.overview: Jeremy wears a pink T-shirt with white pants with black shoes and a black ribbon on his pants with yellow hair and sunglasses that cover his eyes.

items.name: Jungle Pirate
items.overview: The Jungle Pirates wear a green and yellow shirt with a green bowtie and yellow shoes with yellow fur and bunny ears on their head. They use the Demented Mouse Face.

items.name: Kilo Admiral
items.overview: The Kilo Admiral wears green clothes with watermelon images, green bracelets, dark green shoes, a green helmet covering brown hair, a green umbrella on her head, and the Lei on her neck. She uses the Winky face.

items.name: King Neptune
items.overview: King Neptune is located in front of the corals to the right of the Fishman Warriors.

items.name: King Red Head
items.overview: King Red Head can be found in the prisoners cell along with the Gladiators, under the Colosseum (Second Sea).

items.name: Kitsune Lord
items.overview: The Kitsune Lord is location on the 10th floor of a dungeon. He is the second boss the player faces at any difficulty.

items.name: Lab Subordinate
items.overview: The Lab Subordinates wear a brown coat, a white shirt, blue pants with blue hair, they use the Mildly Irritated Face.

items.name: Lava Golem
items.overview: The Lava Golems are large, rocky, humanoid creatures made out of magma and rocks with yellow glowing eyes. They are tall with sharp, yellow claws, and have a pair of orange horns on their head, along with a hole on their waist and yellow-tipped spikes covering their entire body. Their burly physique suggests the word "Golem" in their name.

items.name: Lava Pirate
items.overview: The Lava Pirates wear red clothes with a grey ribbon and brown gloves with red and black wings and red hair, they use the Don't Wake Me Up face

items.name: Layandikit12
items.overview: Layandikit12 could be found inside a cake castle in the Cake Land, in a room with large bookshelves, near the dough raid door. It could be seen standing next to a red couch.

items.name: Legendary Sword Dealer

fields.location: Kingdom of RoseGreen ZoneGraveyard IslandRemote Island

items.overview: The Legendary Sword Dealer wears a formal, all-black outfit consisting of a sleek suit jacket with matching trousers, paired with a crisp white shirt and a black tie. Completing the look is a classic black fedora, giving the character a sharp, mysterious, and elegant appearance.

items.name: Leviathan
items.overview: The Leviathan can be summoned by the Frozen Watcher.

items.name: Lightning Bandit
items.overview: The Lightning Bandits wear two cyan circles on the head, alongside a blue jacket and a light blue short.

items.name: Living Skeleton
items.overview: The Living Skeleton will sell the player the Soul Cane for 750,000.

items.name: Living Zombie
items.overview: The Living Zombies wear damaged white shirts with green and purple skin and brown hair. They use the Zombie Face.

items.name: Longma
items.overview: Longma is located at the Floating Turtle, behind a door near the Previous Hero. This boss is only accessible after completing the Tushita Puzzle in the Third Sea.

items.name: Lucien

fields.location: Hot and ColdCastle on the SeaSimulation Hub

items.overview: Lucien is located at Hot and Cold Island in the Second Sea, Castle on the Sea in the Third Sea and the Simulation Hub.

items.name: Luckymaxer (Boss)
items.overview: Luckymaxer has medium-length brown hair, a white bunny-eared hat with a small burst effect, a blue sleeveless shirt, and light green pants as well as yellow arms. He also wields the Ban Hammer.

items.name: Luckymaxer (NPC)
items.overview: After defeating the Luckymaxer raid boss, the player can interact with this NPC and roll for a Plastic Fruit for free.

items.name: Lunoven
items.overview: Lunoven is located in the bar in front of the raid room at Castle on the Sea, Third Sea.

items.name: Luxury Boat Dealer
items.overview: Players can spawn luxury boats by interacting with the Luxury Boat Dealer.

items.name: Mad Scientist

fields.location: SkylandsHot and ColdCastle on the Sea

items.overview: The Mad Scientist sells the Electric Fighting Style at the cost of 500,000.

items.name: Magic Elf
items.overview: The Magic Elf can be found inside of snowman tent at the North Pole event island, close to the center.

items.name: Magma Admiral
items.overview: The Magma Admiral stands with resolve, wearing a white long coat that drapes from his torso to his lower leg (not be confused with the coat on his back). He is seen with a deep blue shirt that is similar to a marine uniform, and simple black pants. His headwear includes a pale white cap that says "MARINE", and he has a distinct white coat that hangs on his back like a cape.

items.name: Magma Ninja
items.overview: The Magma Ninjas wear brown clothing paired with black shoes, as well as yellow and brown gloves. They also have a yellow belt and two scarves—one yellow and one red with black accents. Additionally, they wear a red hat with a black ribbon that covers the lower part of their face.

items.name: Manager
items.overview: The Manager wears a forest green apron over a black dress shirt, equipped with black pants. He has dark green sneakers, combed jet black hair, and mildly tanned skin that complements the smile on his face.

items.name: Marine
items.overview: The Marine is located at the stairs leading to the Vice Admiral.

items.name: Marine Captain
items.overview: The Marine Captains have jet-black slicked up hair and a grim expression. They wear a white and blue navy coat that has some golden decorations, and a blue necktie. They also have a white shirt with golden buttons, blue pants, black shoes, and Aura covering their hands and swords.

items.name: Marine Commodore
items.overview: The Marine Commodores wear the typical Marine uniform and brown hair. They use the Raig Face.

items.name: Marine Leader
items.overview: The Marine Leader wears the costume of a sea captain with yellow hair, wears the Heeeeeey face.

items.name: Marine Lieutenant
items.overview: The Marine Lieutenants possess brown, combed hair and a unibrow. They wear a blue and white navy coat with gold decorations, and a blue necktie, plus a white button-up shirt, blue pants and black shoes.

items.name: Marine Quest Giver
items.overview: The Marine Quest Giver can be found upon going straight from the Green Zone, facing backwards behind a rock.

items.name: Marine Rear Admiral
items.overview: The Marine Rear Admirals are Lv. 1725 enemies.

items.name: Marine Recruiter
items.overview: Marine Recruiter can switch the player from the Pirates side to the Marines side when the player is a Pirate without having to quit and rejoin the game. When the player switches, their character will be reset before joining the opposite team. This means that if the player has an item (Blox Fruit or a God's Chalice) in their hotbar and switches, that item(s) will be lost.

items.name: Marine Tree Quest Giver
items.overview: The Marine Tree Quest Giver can be found in the lower level of Great Tree, in front of the Marine Commodores.

items.name: Martial Arts Master
items.overview: The Martial Arts Master is a shop NPC that can teach the Superhuman Fighting Style for 3,000,000.

items.name: Master of Auras

fields.location: Green ZoneSnow MountainHot and ColdCursed ShipIce CastleForgotten IslandPort TownCastle on the SeaHydra IslandGreat TreeFloating Turtle

items.overview: The Master of Auras can sell the player Aura Colors where the colors come in 2 rarities, Regular and LEGENDARY.

items.name: Master Sword Dealer
items.overview: The Master Sword Dealer is located at the fourth island of Skylands.

items.name: Mercenary
items.overview: The Mercenaries wear blue clothing that looks like armor with a black warrior helmet covering their entire face.

items.name: Military Detective
items.overview: The Military Detective is located at the Prison.

items.name: Military Soldier
items.overview: The Military Soldiers wear a black shirt and pants with a white stripe and a black cap, they use the Serious Scar Face.

items.name: Military Spy
items.overview: The Military Spies wear a black shirt and pants with yellow stripes and also the top part of the shirt is red and they also wear a red hood and a blindfold with red eyes.

items.name: Mob Leader
items.overview: The Mob Leader wears a black and gray shirt and pants with black hair, he uses the face "Hmmm".

items.name: Mole
items.overview: The Mole can be found among the God's Guards and upon entering the Upper Skylands.

items.name: Monkey
items.overview: The Monkeys have brown skin with tan-yellow hands and rosy cheeks on their face.

items.name: Mr. Captain
items.overview: Mr. Captain is located at the docks of the Green Zone, to the right of the Bridge that connects the Kingdom of Rose to the Green Zone.

items.name: Musketeer Pirate
items.overview: The Musketeer Pirates wear a purple shirt with a blue and white swimsuit, white pants, a ribbon on their pants, black shoes, a headband with flowers, and bunny ears. They use the Demented Mouse Face. Additionally they have a ponytail with light brown hair.

items.name: Mysterious Entity
items.overview: Mysterious Entity (formerly known as Wenlocktoad Over Heaven) is an NPC that can be used to awaken the players fruit.

items.name: Mysterious Force
items.overview: When the player interacts with King Red Head, he will tell the player to go to the Great Tree. Upon reaching the top of the tree, they will encounter the Mysterious Force. Interacting with it will teleport the player to the Temple of Time.

items.name: Mysterious Man
items.overview: The Mysterious Man is a Misc. NPC who sells the True Triple Katana for 2,000,000. Though he is labelled as a "man", his appearance seems otherworldly.

items.name: Mysterious Scientist

fields.location: Hot and ColdCastle on the Sea

items.overview: In the Second Sea, the NPC can be found in the laboratory in the cold zone. The player has to enter this code with the color panels: Red, Blue, Green, and Blue (1, 3, 2, 3 taps). After entering the code, a "secret door" in the form of a rectangular doorway will open, leading to a very long spiral slope. After climbing up the slope, the player should be able to see the NPC in between 8 tubes. The player must unequip anything that is currently equipped, or entering the code will not be possible.

items.name: Mythological Pirate
items.overview: The Mythological Pirates are badgers with red clothes.

items.name: Nerd
items.overview: Nerd is an NPC that will tell the player the buff(s) of the accessory that they are wearing upon being interacted with.

items.name: Norp
items.overview: norp was able to be found at a round table in the Café.

items.name: Ocean Prophet
items.overview: The Ocean Prophets are located at the Submerged Island to the left of spawn on a hill where a bridge connects to it.

items.name: Oni (NPC)
items.overview: During the Red King Event, the Oni allows players to teleport into the Oni Realm.

items.name: Oni Fisherman
items.overview: The Oni Fisherman could be found in the Oni Realm, on the right side of the dojo.

items.name: Oni Soldier
items.overview: The Oni Soldiers spawn every five minutes in the Oni Realm. Whenever they spawn, a system message will appear, saying: "A squad of Oni Guards has appeared." A total of 12 Oni Soldiers can be found at once, four on each island.

items.name: Orbitus
items.overview: Orbitus can be found at the Green Zone island in Second Sea. To find him, the player can walk straight and then to the right from the Marine Quest Giver.

items.name: Order
items.overview: Order has 256,250 HP, and uses the moves of nearly all moves of old Control and all moves of Koko. However, he cannot use the Control’s old [V] Gamma Rush.

items.name: Parlus
items.overview: Parlus wears a copper colored coat which exposes his abs. He bears a black pant and neatly combed hair with one strand sticking out in the front. He stands with his right hand behind his head.

items.name: Party Gacha
items.overview: The Party Gacha was located on the outermost floor of the Grand Colosseum during the 50B Celebration Event.

items.name: Peanut President
items.overview: The Peanut Presidents wear a brown and white shirt with a brown tie and brown pants with a brown visor with red pupils and orange hair.

items.name: Peanut Quest Giver
items.overview: The Peanut Quest Giver can be found in the Peanut Land of Sea of Treats, near the Peanut Scouts.

items.name: Peanut Scout
items.overview: The Peanut Scouts appear to be bulky, big men with muscular arms. They also wear a bandana on their face, covering their mouth.

items.name: Phoeyu, the Reformed
items.overview: Phoeyu, the Reformed is an NPC that sells the Death Step Fighting Style.

items.name: Piranha
items.overview: Piranhas are capable of leaping out of the water to attack both the player's boat and the player directly. They utilize biting and electric shocks as their primary forms of attack. When a player is hit by a Piranha, their ability to dash, jump, and use abilities is temporarily disabled. Piranhas will automatically despawn if they move too far from their original spawn point. Notably, they prioritize targeting the player over the boat and cannot be damaged using M1 attacks from fighting styles or swords.

items.name: Pirate
items.overview: The Pirates wear a pirate hat with skull on the side of it, as well as a red suit with buttons, some of which are unbuttoned, thus revealing their chest. A white leather belt is tied on their waist. They also wear black pants and red shoes.

items.name: Pirate Adventurer
items.overview: The Pirate Adventurer wears a semi-open white shirt with black pants and blue hair, he uses the Suspicious face.

items.name: Pirate Millionaire
items.overview: The Pirate Millionaires wear brown shoes with black pants and a shirt with white and red stripes with black hair and an eye patch covering their left eye. They use the Mildly Irritated Face.

items.name: Pirate Port Quest Giver
items.overview: The Pirate Port Quest Giver can be found on the lower level of Port Town, close to the wooden docks and the Pirate Millionaires.

items.name: Pirate Recruiter
items.overview: The Pirate Recruiter can switch the player from the Marine side to the Pirate side when the player is a Marine without having to quit and rejoin the game. When the player switches, their character will be reset before joining the opposite team. This means that if the player has an item (Blox Fruit or a God's Chalice) in their hotbar and switches, that item(s) will be lost.

items.name: Pistol Billionaire
items.overview: The Pistol Billionaires wear a semi-open yellow shirt with ribbons on their muscles and a belt under their shirt and they wear blue pants with brown shoes and brown hair, they use the Raig Face.

items.name: Player Hunter
items.overview: Similar to the Wanted Poster, the Player Hunter can give players a quest for killing a random player on the server, and the player can only receive quests for players who have their PvP on. When the player receives the quest, the Player Hunter will provide the random player's location. If the player has a quest, and another player kills the player that the player is assigned on the quest, their quest will be cancelled. After the player finishes the quest, a cooldown of 10 minutes will be set up for their next one.

items.name: Plokster

fields.location: Kingdom of RoseCastle on the Sea

items.overview: Plokster can be found on the bridge between Kingdom of Rose and Green Zone, as well as inside the building with a blue roof at the Castle on the Sea.

items.name: Posessed Mummy
items.overview: The Posessed Mummies wear a black shirt with yellow ribbons all over various parts of their body with blue pants with their legs sewn together and a ribbon across their face with one eye and an Egyptian hat with a snake.

items.name: Previous Hero
items.overview: The Previous Hero is a Misc NPC that sells the Electric Claw fighting style.

items.name: Prisoner
items.overview: The Prisoners wear a black and white prisoner outfit with a Pal Hair and have a scar on their left cheek.

items.name: Raid Bosses
items.overview: Raid Bosses are enemies that are normally stronger than normal bosses.

items.name: Raider
items.overview: The Raiders wear red and black clothes with a red ribbon on their chest and brown hair with the face Dont Wake Me Up.

items.name: Rear Crew Quest Giver
items.overview: The Rear Crew Quest Giver can be found to the left upon entering the Cursed Ship, near the entrance to the Ship Deckhands.

items.name: Reborn Skeleton
items.overview: The Reborn Skeletons are located at the graveyard to the left of the Haunted Castle, in the Third Sea.

items.name: Red Army Recruiter
items.overview: The Red Army Recruiter was located on near the outer wall of the Grand Colosseum. He stood at the beginning of the road leading to the Oni Realm

items.name: Red Commander
items.overview: The Red Commander spawned every hour at XX:30 (12:30, 1:30, 2:30, etc.) in the Oni Realm (Interior) and despawns after 15 minutes. The following system messages will appear when he spawns: "The entrance to the Oni Realm is opening...", followed by "The Red Commander beckons from his throne." at which the boss spawns. After 15 minutes have passed, the following system message appeared when the Red Commander despawns: "Your strength fails to impress the Red Commander—he vanishes."

items.name: Red Gacha
items.overview: The Red Gacha can be found in the Oni Realm.

items.name: Red Infantry
items.overview: The Red Infantry arrive in waves in the Celestial Domain during a Raid upon the Spirit tree.

items.name: Red Legionnaire
items.overview: The Red Legionnaires arrive during a raid upon the Spirit Tree of the Celestial Domain.

items.name: Reef Bandit
items.overview: The Reef Bandits are located at the Submerged Island in a reef like area to the right of spawn

items.name: Remove Blox Fruit
items.overview: Remove Blox Fruit can be found at the Prison on one of the surrounding circles in the First Sea, and on the roof of the largest building at the Castle on the Sea in the Third Sea.

items.name: Rich Man
items.overview: The Rich Man wears a light blue t-shirt with clean brown pants with some white highlights. He wears black shoes and has a golden beard and hair which are connected.

items.name: Rip Commander
items.overview: The Rip Commander spawns every hour at XX:30 (12:30, 1:30, 2:30, etc.) in the Celestial Domain (Interior) and will despawn after 15 minutes have passed. The following system messages will appear when he spawns: "The Celestial Domain's lift has been activated.", followed by "RIP Commander beckons from his throne." at which the boss spawns. After 15 minutes have passed, the following system message will appear when the Rip Commander despawns: "The Rip Commander has grown tired of waiting for a proper challenge — he disappears."

items.name: Rip Family Recruiter
items.overview: The Rip Family Recruiter was located on near the outer wall of the Grand Colosseum. He stood by the beginning of the road that leads to the Celestial Domain.

items.name: Rip indra
items.overview: rip_indra takes the appearance of the admin rip_indra's old avatar.

items.name: Rip indra (NPC)
items.overview: rip_indra's only purpose is to switch the skin of the player's Dark Blade, the only options given are to switch to either the Slayer Skin or the default one.

items.name: Rip indra True Form
items.overview: rip_indra spawns inside the palace of Castle on the Sea in the Third Sea once spawned. The player can tell when Indra is spawned, as everyone’s screen shakes, and the world's atmosphere becomes covered in thick fog. The fog is very thick, so it's a bit difficult to see clearly. Similar to the Mirage Island's fog.

items.name: Rip Infantry
items.overview: The Red Infantry arrive in waves in the Oni Realm during a Raid upon the Spirit tree.

items.name: Rip Legionnaire
items.overview: The Rip Legionnaires arrive during a raid upon the Spirit Tree of the Oni Realm

items.name: Rip return
items.overview: rip_return has white legs and torso, with blue arms, and a necklace. He wears a silver pumpkin on his head with protruding horns. He also has a pair of angel wings. The model is a representation of the developer, rip_return's Roblox avatar.

items.name: Robotmega
items.overview: Robotmega can be found in the Middle Town, next to Aura Editor, in the house with the green roof.

items.name: Royal Soldier
items.overview: The Royal Soldiers wear white clothes with black shoes and a brown necklace that has a white hook and the head display is an angry goat head with a red headband with horns.

items.name: Royal Squad
items.overview: The Royal Squads wear pink clothes with Angel Wings on their back and brown hair, they use the Glory on the Gridiron face.

items.name: Saber Expert
items.overview: The Saber Expert has red hair, wears a white vest-type shirt and a black cape and has brown to black pants. He has a short beard and a small moustache and he bears a double scar beneath his left eye.

items.name: Sabi

fields.location: Kingdom of RoseCastle on the Sea

items.overview: Sabi wears a purple scarf, light orange vest, and blue pants with black shoes. He has orange hair and he wears the Top Hat.

items.name: Santa Claws
items.overview: Santa Claws can be found near the Boat Dealers at the North Pole in each sea.

items.name: Sea Beast

fields.location: Sea Danger Level 1-6, Second Sea and Third Sea waters
fields.atkPerHit: Deadly Shower: up to 2100 Water Beam: 1500 Roaring Beast: 500
fields.drops: General Drops +1 Level 60,000-250,000 Choppa Top Hat 250-150 Second Sea 250 Fist of Darkness Third Sea 150 350

items.overview: Sea Beasts, unlike most aggressive NPCs, are only vulnerable to special moves and are immune to most M1 attacks. There are some exceptions to these such as:

items.name: Sea Captain
items.overview: The Sea Captain is located on the docks of the Kingdom of Rose, Second Sea.

items.name: Sea Chanter
items.overview: The Sea Chanters are located at the Submerged Island to the left of spawn near a bridge.

items.name: Sea Soldier
items.overview: The Sea Soldiers wear a red and black t-shirt with black and red pants and red shoes with a gas mask and red and black hair.

items.name: Sealed King
items.overview: The Sealed King is the starter NPC for the Race Awakening quest. He is King Red Head and is currently believed to be sealed here by rip_indra.

items.name: Serpent Hunter
items.overview: The Serpent Hunters are located at Tiki Outpost, in the Third Sea.

items.name: Shafi
items.overview: Shafi can be found in a base linked by a tunnel near the Island Boys at Tiki Outpost, Third Sea.

items.name: Shanda
items.overview: The Shandas have brown spiky hair and small, white angel wings on their backs, with their abs and muscles exposed, and a shirt that appears to be torn. In addition to this, they wear metal elbow and shoulder guards, alongside red pants.

items.name: Shark (Enemy)
items.overview: The Sharks randomly spawn in groups of 1-5 in Second Sea and in Sea Danger Level 0-6 in Third Sea (can also spawn in First sea for easter event)

items.name: Shark Hunter
items.overview: The Shark Hunter can be found in Tiki Outpost, in the first door at the left of the central building when the player enters Tiki Outpost, Third Sea.

items.name: Sharkman Master
items.overview: The Sharkman Master is located inside the Sealed Cavern, which is near the Coral Pirates, behind a house.

items.name: Sharkman Teacher
items.overview: The Sharkman Teacher (formerly Daigrock, the Sharkman) is an NPC that teaches Sharkman Karate.

items.name: Ship Deckhand
items.overview: The Ship Deckhands wear a torn blue shirt with a brown belt and blue pants with blue shoes and brown hair, they use the Don't Wake Me Up Face.

items.name: Ship Engineer
items.overview: The Ship Engineers wear engineer t-shirts with torn and dirty black pants with a towel on their heads.

items.name: Ship Officer
items.overview: The Ship Officers wear yellow and black clothing with a brown hat and a mask that covers part of their face.

items.name: Ship Steward
items.overview: The Ship Stewards wear white clothes with black lines and black shoes with a chef's hat.

items.name: Shipwright Teacher
items.overview: The Shipwright Teacher wears a white short-sleeved shirt with a red sweater underneath, red bands on his waist and arms, a brown belt with a fancy silver buckle, and black pants with a red stripe. He also has neat, jet-black hair, toned muscles, and a black and red tricorn hat.

items.name: Shocker
items.overview: The Shockers have blonde hair and clothes that appear to be torn, exposing their chest and abs. In addition to this, electrical power flows from their fists.

items.name: Sick Man
items.overview: The Sick Man is a fairly white man wearing a brown short-sleeved ragged shirt, with bandages on his right arm and abdomen. He wears ragged beige colored pants with only a shoe on his left foot. He has a black beard and a small brown hat on his head.

items.name: Sick Scientist
items.overview: The Sick Scientist is located behind the Cookie Crafter's spawn location, at the left edge of Cake Land, Sea of Treats, Third Sea.

items.name: Skull Slayer
items.overview: The Skull Slayers are located at the Tiki Outpost, Third Sea.

items.name: Sky Adventurer
items.overview: The Sky Adventurer is located at the island above the Dark Masters in Skylands.

items.name: Sky Bandit
items.overview: The Sky Bandits have spiky blue hair and a headband that resembles a ninja's. They have wings sprouting from their back and wear a short-sleeve, open-collar suit with white pants. On their necks, they wear multiple jewelry items.

items.name: Sky Quest Giver 2
items.overview: The Sky Quest Giver 2 can be found at the second area of the Upper Skylands, under a tree.

items.name: Smoke Admiral
items.overview: The Smoke Admiral has blue hair, wears a blue shirt with black pants and brown shoes with the Coat on his back.

items.name: Snow Bandit
items.overview: The Snow Bandits wear a brown, white and blue shirt and pants and also have blue hair and use the Don't Wake Me Up Face.

items.name: Snow Demon
items.overview: The Snow Demons can be found at Candy Cane Land, Sea of Treats, Third Sea.

items.name: Snow Lurker
items.overview: The Snow Lurkers wear a black and blue puffy coat vest, black shirt, black pants with blue, decorated knee-pads, and black and white shoes. They also sport a black parka hood with a white fur lining, black balaclava, and Aura on their fists.

items.name: Snow Quest Giver
items.overview: The Snow Quest Giver is located at the left side of Snow Mountain, near the bridge.

items.name: Snow Trooper
items.overview: The Snow Troopers wears blue and black pants with a black vest and a gray t-shirt with torn black gloves on his hands and gray and white hair, they wear the Don't Wake Me Up face.

items.name: Snowman
items.overview: The Snowmans are sentient snowmans with root-like stick legs and arms, a scary face, and ice horns. They wear a scarf and some buttons on their chest, with some bits of frozen ice scattered around their body.

items.name: Sorcerer
items.overview: The Sorcerers wear a grey mask and a green shirt without sleeves, making it possible to see their muscular arms. In addition to this, they are clothed in black pants and gray shoes.

items.name: Soul Reaper
items.overview: "An unknown being has entered this world..."

items.name: Spy
items.overview: If the player gives the spy 1,500, the player can bribe the Spy. To fully bribe the Spy, the player will need four bribes for a total of 6,000. Once qualified, it will increase the chance of Frozen Dimension spawning.

items.name: Statue
items.overview: The Statue is located at the Trial of Flames, Prehistoric Island.

items.name: Stone
items.overview: Stone wears a white shirt with a pink belt and bright blue pants with brown shoes and blue hair. He also uses the Mildly Irritated Face.

items.name: Submarine Worker
items.overview: The Submarine Worker can be found behind the submarine at Tiki Outpost, near the Sun-kissed Warriors and below the spawn of Tyrant of the Skies.

items.name: Submerged Quest Giver 1
items.overview: The Submerged Quest Giver 1 can be found on the right side of the Submerged Island, in front of a orange coral among the Coral Pirates.

items.name: Submerged Quest Giver 2
items.overview: The Submerged Quest Giver 2 can be found in the middle of the Submerged Island, on a pile of sand.

items.name: Submerged Quest Giver 3
items.overview: The Submerged Quest Giver 3 can be found far south of the Submerged Island, on a some stone.

items.name: Summer Gacha
items.overview: The Summer Gacha was a limited-time NPC introduced during the Summer Event. It allows the player to purchase a random physical Blox Fruit in exchange for 500 Summer Tokens.

items.name: Sun-kissed Warrior
items.overview: The Sun-kissed Warriors can be found at Tiki Outpost, Third Sea.

items.name: Swan
items.overview: The Swan wears a uniquely styled black and red shirt with crimson red sunglasses. He has black hair, and wears the Pink Coat on his back.

items.name: Swan Pirate
items.overview: The Swan Pirates wear a coat that exposes their muscles, brown pants, and have red hair along with a Mildly Irritated Face.

items.name: Sweet Crafter
items.overview: The Sweet Crafter is located near the center of Chocolate Land, the sub-island of Sea of Treats, Third Sea.

items.name: Sweet Thief
items.overview: The Sweet Thiefs are located at Chocolate Land, Sea of Treats, close to the quest giver.

items.name: Sword Dealer
items.overview: The Sword Dealer can be found on both the Pirate and Marine starter islands.

items.name: Sword Dealer of the East
items.overview: The Sword Dealer of the East is a Shop NPC.

items.name: Sword Dealer of the West
items.overview: The Sword Dealer of the West can be found in the Pirate Village, behind the Pirates.

items.name: Tacomura
items.overview: Tacomura is located in the Castle on the Sea, near the stairs where the Barista Cousin sometimes appears, in the Third Sea.

items.name: Terrorshark
items.overview: The Terrorshark has a chance to spawn between Sea Danger Levels 2-6. When spawned, it will swim around the player(s) boat and constantly attack the player(s) until the boat/target dies. As the Sea Danger Level increases, the Terrorshark will progressively get stronger and harder to defeat. It is recommended to not go past Danger Level 5 as the Terrorsharks that spawn there are very powerful. Although higher levels do not increase health, they will carry more sharks and do greater damage. It is also almost impossible to escape from the Terrorshark, however fast fruits, such as Light, and boats, such as The Sentinel can sometimes outrun them.

items.name: The Gorilla King
items.overview: The Gorilla King resembles Gorillas, but bigger. There are certain distinguishing features, such as the crown on its head, its different skin color and the Aura that covers its hands.

items.name: The Mayor
items.overview: The Mayor is located in front of a house near the Military Soldiers.

items.name: The Saw
items.overview: "The Saw has spawned in the game! You have 15 minutes to kill him and possibly get a rare reward!"

items.name: The Strongest God
items.overview: The Strongest God be found in the Second Sea on Remote Island.

items.name: Thunder God
items.overview: The Thunder God wears brown, white, and blue pants with a blue ribbon and has the Tomoe Ring on his back. Despite this, he does not drop the Tomoe Ring.

items.name: Thunder God (NPC)
items.overview: The Thunder God was found at the Mini Sky Island, which was accessible after completing a Rumble Raid with the requirements below. The island can still be reached by flying above the Kingdom of Rose in the Second Sea, far away from all islands in the Third Sea. However, the player cannot purchase Pole (2nd Form) even if all requirements are met ever since after Update 27.

items.name: Tide Keeper
items.overview: The Tide Keeper wears green pants with a green ribbon, golden skeletons on his shoulders, yellow shoes with green hair and the Dont Wake Me Up face.

items.name: Tiki Quest Giver 1
items.overview: The Tiki Quest Giver 1 can be found in the right side of Tiki Outpost, in front of a building between the Isle Outlaws and Island Boys.

items.name: Tiki Quest Giver 2
items.overview: The Tiki Quest Giver 2 can be found in the left side of Tiki Outpost, in front of a building between the Sun-kissed Warriors and Isle Champions.

items.name: Tiki Quest Giver 3
items.overview: The Tiki Quest Giver 3 can be found in the left side of Tiki Outpost, on top of a wooden platform among the Serpent Hunters and Skull Slayers.

items.name: Titles Specialist
items.overview: The Titles Specialist is located in the Café (Second Sea). The player needs to head to the left side and pick up the silver chest in order to reveal the basement. They can then climb down the ladder and the Titles Specialist will be directly in front of them.

items.name: Toga Warrior
items.overview: The Toga Warriors wear red and white striped clothing with a white helmet, and the face they use is the Serious Scar Face.

items.name: Tort
items.overview: tort can be found in the Café and in the Turtle Mansion.

items.name: Tournament Master
items.overview: The Tournament Master could be found in the following places:

items.name: Trainee
items.overview: The Trainees have black hair and wear standard marine clothing. They also have the Serious Scar Face.

items.name: Training Dummy
items.overview: The Training Dummy is located behind the Arena Trainer.

items.name: Treasure Inventory
items.overview: The Treasure Inventory functioned similar to the Inventory, only allowing the player to store one fruit at a time, but could be upgraded with the Fruit Storage Gamepass. It could not store Materials, as they didn't exist around the time of this function.

items.name: Trevor
items.overview: Trevor offers the player to give him a physical fruit that has a value of 1,000,000 or higher in order to access Don Swan's room.

items.name: Trinket Expert
items.overview: The Trinket Expert is located in the Simulation Hub, standing beside the Trinket Refiner underneath the globe-like machinery nearby the Dungeons matchmaking area.

items.name: Trinket Refiner
items.overview: The Trinket Refiner is located in the Simulation Hub, besides the Trinket Expert underneath the globe-like machinery nearby the Dungeons matchmaking area.

items.name: Turtle Adventure Quest Giver
items.overview: The Turtle Adventure Quest Giver can be found near the main gate of the Floating Turtle, near the Fishman Raiders and Fishman Captains.

items.name: Tyrant of the Skies
items.overview: The Tyrant of the Skies has a muscular build alongside brown spikey hair, a red vest, blue and gold shorts as well as black boots. He also wields the Flail, a golden bird-like helmet (Feathered Visage), and tribal tattoos. The Tyrant's massive wings are red, yellow and blue with glowing stripes.

items.name: Unbound Werewolf
items.overview: The Unbound Werewolf was located at the Observatory.

items.name: Urban
items.overview: Urban can spawn in various places in the Third Sea, all spawn locations can be found here.

items.name: Uzoth
items.overview: Uzoth is an NPC in the Third Sea who teaches and upgrades Dragon Talon, which is the V2 form of Dragon Breath.

items.name: Valentines Delivery (NPC)
items.overview: This NPC was added during the 2026 Valentines Event on Feburary 14, 2026. This was a limited time event NPC and got removed prior to the event ending.

items.name: Valentines Gacha Dealer
items.overview: The Valentines Gacha Dealer was an limited-time event NPC.

items.name: Vampire
items.overview: The Vampires wear a dark vampire costume with black hair and the Classic Vampire Face.

items.name: Venomous Assailant
items.overview: The Venomous Assailants are clad in entirely black attire, accented by minimal purple detailing and a dark gray sash encircling the waist. A black mask conceals the lower half of their face, while a black conical hat is worn atop the head.

items.name: Vice Admiral
items.overview: The Vice Admiral wears a white and red shirt which is open, black and white pants with red shoes, along with the Coat on his back. He has dark toned blue hair, and wields the Triple Katana upon encounter.

items.name: Villager
items.overview: The Villager is located beside a house near the Snow Bandits.

items.name: Warden
items.overview: The Warden sports a black bodysuit that covers his chest and legs, along with several metal plates and black bands on his torso, ankle and shoulders. He has well-defined muscles on his arms and wears a black helmet with blue horns on it.

items.name: Water Fighter
items.overview: The Water Fighters wear a purple and black t-shirt with black pants and shorts with a purple and black hat with purple and black wings, they wear the Sigmund face.

items.name: Water Kung-fu Teacher

fields.location: Underwater CityHot and ColdCastle on the Sea

items.overview: The Water Kung-fu Teacher is located at the Underwater City, behind the palace, directly to its right. He is inside the part of the wall with a slight color difference. To get inside, the player can go on the left of the wall. The Water Kung-fu Teacher can also be found at Hot and Cold and the Castle on the Sea. There is no level requirement to talk to him or purchase the fighting style.

items.name: Weapon Dealer
items.overview: The Weapon Dealer is located near the fountain at the center of Middle Town, in the First Sea.

items.name: Weird Machine
items.overview: The Weird Machine is located in the basement near the machine opposite the entrance to the downstairs in the Haunted Castle. Players who have not completed the Skull Guitar Puzzle yet will not be able to see the Weird Machine.

items.name: Wenlocktoad Over Heaven
items.overview: When talked to, Wenlocktoad Over Heaven's name would display as "KING WENLOCKTOAD-SAMA OVER HEAVEN" in the dialogue window.

items.name: Winter Gacha
items.overview: The Winter Gacha offered players limited-time event items as well as random Blox Fruits at the cost of 100 Candies. The cooldown for one roll is 2 hours, and the cooldown was shared with the Random Fruit gacha.

items.name: Winter Warrior
items.overview: The Winter Warriors wear a dirty white t-shirt with dirty black and yellow pants and gloves with a visor that covers their eyes and red hair.

items.name: Witch
items.overview: The Witch could have been found at the center of the Middle Town, inside of the Café and outside of the Mansion in the First, Second, and Third Seas respectively.

items.name: Wysper
items.overview: Wysper wears a grey neck accessory with red sleeves as well as pink shorts with white ends, along with brown hair shaved on the sides. He uses the Furious George Face.

items.name: Yeti (Boss)
items.overview: The Yeti is a reskin of The Gorilla King boss. However, it does not have the same six-pack of the latter, and uses a different head model. It is covered from head to toe in whitish-blue fur, with flatter, ice-like surfaces on its hands and feet. On its face is a large, flat nose, white eyes with red tints and a large, open mouth with large and sharp teeth. It has fluffy hair and a long, mane-like beard appearing on both his head and neck.

items.name: Yoshi
items.overview: Yoshi can be found on the left side of the roof of the castle on the second island of Skylands.

items.name: Zero
items.overview: Zero is located on the 20th floor of a dungeon, specifically on Hard mode. He is typically the last boss you fight before the dungeon ends and you can claim your rewards (unless you're doing Challenge difficulty).

items.name: Zombie
items.overview: The Zombies wear an emerald-green, tattered shirt, and black, mud-stained, torn jeans with loose fibers hanging over the holes. They have black, spiky hair, monstrous faces, and light green skin.
